parties: Government of Gujarat (via Energy & Petrochemicals Department) and Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited
headline: Government of Gujarat Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure for Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited
sum: Government of Gujarat's Energy & Petrochemicals Department filed a SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure (Reg. 31(4)–(5)) with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition in Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited. The filing itself does not publish the acquisition value, shareholding percentage achieved, or specific transaction terms in the publicly available header.
detail: The Energy & Petrochemicals Department of the Government of Gujarat submitted a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) to NSE on 19 June 2026. These regulations require persons acquiring 5% or more in a listed company to file continuous disclosures of shareholding and acquisition intent. The filing confirms a substantial transaction, but the specific shareholding percentage, consideration, and acquisition structure remain in the detailed Form 31(4)/31(5) not reproduced in the NSE header document.
